_about: Media presets. verified = read on the official page (date). unverified = from search snippets, check the upload form. Update when a platform changes its rules.

cover_rules: only the game title as text (no New/Updated/Play now)
video_rules: no sound
no black screen or logo intro
no black bars
no mouse cursor
no Play Now or promo text
no app or social icons
no fast-forward (they speed it up slightly)
animation allowed only if it represents gameplay
first frame: docs recommend the static cover (--cover-first); 11 of 12 top previews (reference base 2026-11-21) open straight on action
published previews: 6-19 s (typical 10-15), 0-7 hard cuts, game HUD kept, behind-the-hero camera
portrait 2:3: hero kept in the centre (native 2:3 take or a crop that follows the hero)
crazygames.screens_note: no screenshot field in the CrazyGames form (checked 2026-11-26)

cover_rules: full-bleed square, no borders, padding or letterboxing
video_rules: muted
2-3 scenes of 1-2 s
start from the static artwork
hide non-essential UI
no cursor
minimal text

yandex.verified: unverified (page unreachable 2026-11-20; sizes from search snippets of the official docs)
cover_rules: all words on icon, cover, screenshots and video translated into each localization language
promo materials must not repeat another game's
video_rules: vertical 9:16 (confirmed); durations and MB limits not confirmed: check the console form

playgama.verified: 2026-11-26 (developer.playgama.com form: Cover Images 1:1 800, 9:16 1080x1920, 16:9 1920x1080; Other Assets screenshots optional)
video_rules: distributed to Yandex/CrazyGames/others: when in doubt also build their presets

ads_landscape.source: Alex's main ad format: 16:9 for ads on game platforms and ad networks (Google Ads App / AdMob, Yandex Direct, YouTube). Limits = the strictest common window of https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/9948381 ; https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/17091269 ; https://yandex.com/support/direct/en/efficiency/video ; https://www.yandex.com/support/direct/products-mobile-apps-ads/recommendations.html
ads_landscape.verified: 2026-11-21 (search snippets of the official help pages: Google 10-60 s, 1920x1080; Yandex 5-60 s, first 15 s used, 16:9 recommended, 20-30 fps, 100 MB)
video_rules: the strong part must fit the first 15 s (Yandex uses only 15 s; viewers skip after 5 s)
hook in the first 1.5 s
real gameplay only
keep text off the corners: Skip / Ad labels and the app card sit there
end card with title + CTA

admob.source: Google Ads App campaigns (AdMob in-app inventory + YouTube): https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/9948381 ; https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/17091269
admob.verified: 2026-11-21 (search snippets: 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1, 10-60 s each, 1920x1080 / 1080x1920 / 1080x1080; uploaded through YouTube)
video_rules: give all three ratios: the network picks per placement (more ratios = more inventory)
several hooks per ratio for A/B (Google recommends up to 20 videos)
9:16: app metadata covers the top 10% and bottom 25%
upload goes through YouTube (unlisted): Alex uploads

yandex_direct.source: Yandex Direct mobile app / video ads: https://yandex.com/support/direct/en/efficiency/video ; https://www.yandex.com/support/direct/products-mobile-apps-ads/recommendations.html
yandex_direct.verified: 2026-11-21 (search snippets: 5-60 s but only the first 15 s are used, 16:9 / 1:1 / 9:16, 1080p, 20-30 fps, mp4, 100 MB)
video_rules: 15 s max: Yandex uses only the first 15 s
texts in Russian for RU campaigns
video banners accept 16:9 only

ads_vertical.source: general practice for TikTok / Reels / Shorts (not Alex's main target; only on request)
video_rules: hook in the first 1.5 s
show real gameplay (misleading ads get rejected)
keep text out of the bottom ~22% and top ~12% (UI overlays)
end card with title + CTA

ads_square.source: general practice for feed ads (Meta / VK)

google_play.source: Google Play install ads = Google Ads App campaigns (AdMob, YouTube, Search, Play) + store listing graphics: https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9866151
google_play.verified: 2026-11-22 (videos = admob preset; icon 512x512 PNG and feature graphic 1024x500 from the Play Console help, check in the console form)
video_rules: give all three ratios: the network picks per placement (more ratios = more inventory)
several hooks per ratio for A/B (Google recommends up to 20 videos)
9:16: app metadata covers the top 10% and bottom 25%
upload goes through YouTube (unlisted): Alex uploads
google_play.seen_in: ads: inside other apps and YouTube, often muted at first, skippable after 5 s; listing: icon in search results, feature graphic on top of the store page
